_comment: Warning budgets for the context audit. These NEVER fail a run: they warn.
'budget' is the size measured at the last accepted baseline (2026-08-12), so
any growth warns immediately. 'target' is the smaller number the reduction
about a 30% cut. Tighten 'budget' toward 'target' only after a measured
reduction has actually landed and its behavior tests still pass. Never raise
a budget to silence a warning.
